llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and implements a local, file-backed rate-limiter with no network calls or secret access. Before installing: (1) inspect scripts/rate-limiter.py (you already have it — review it completely) and confirm the default state path is acceptable; by default it writes rate-limit-state.json (and a .lock file) in the project/parent directory — change RATE_LIMIT_STATE if you want it elsewhere. (2) Only add the recommended system-prompt or AGENTS.md changes if you trust the source and understand that this will cause the gate to run before many agent actions. (3) Run the gate/status commands manually first to verify behavior (python3 scripts/rate-limiter.py status/gate). (4) If deploying on a shared or production host, run it in a sandbox, and consider setting file permissions and a custom RATE_LIMIT_STATE path. The pre-scan flagged a 'system-prompt-override' pattern because the skill asks you to modify agent/system prompts — that is expected for this use case but is privileged, so review and approve those changes intentionally.
